```{python}
#| label: fig-bond_revenue
#| fig-cap: "Bond Revenue over Time"
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (millions of USD)")
plt.title("Bond Films Revenue over Time")
plt.show()
```

The first Bond year was `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` and the last Bond year was `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.
